Container.Name: engramhalo-flash-next
Container.Overview: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on Strix Halo (gfx1151) via EngramHalo.cpp — a llama.cpp fork with RDNA 3.5 kernel patches, true QSA sparse-attention gather, working MTP, and the 27 GiB engram table kept on SSD (~1 GiB resident). Upstream measured: code decode 24.4 to 39.3 t/s, prefill at 131K depth roughly doubled. [br]Server flags are baked into the image (long-context agent profile: q8_0 KV, mmap lazy-read, MTP + ngram-mod with the EasiiX sidecar). The only mount is /models — no config files, no env vars. [br]Supersedes qwen38-flash-next-rocm (kyuz0 toolbox). Requires the Strix Halo host tuning: syslinux append amdgpu.gttsize=117760 amdgpu.no_system_mem_limit=1 ttm.pages_limit=24576000, and BIOS UMA Frame Buffer Size 512M. [br]Optional env overrides exist for operators (MODEL, MTP, CTX, NP, THREADS, MODE=ssd|ram, EXTRA_ARGS) — defaults are fine. Thinking mode is on by default; allow generous max_tokens in clients.
Container.Description: Server config is baked into the image; only model files are mounted. ROCm 7.14 by design (the fork's measured stack). CTX defaults to 163840 — the MTP-validated limit; pass 262144 with MTP empty for full-context no-speculation.

Config.Name: HTTP / API
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible llama-server API (WebUI at root). Container port 6631 to host 6631 — llama.cpp's new default port.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: GGUF files (shared with other llama containers). Expects UD-IQ4_XS shards and mtp-sidecars/EasiiX-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q8_0.gguf.
